title: 第11章 道惊四座第12章 易说修行
content_zh:
消瘦身影独立，阳光落在案台上，映得那半块青桐木上的刻痕格外清晰——正是“易”字的卦爻，纹路间似有微光流转。
葛仙师目光扫过那木牌，又上下打量着眼前这个看似凡俗出身的学子，当看向吴燃灯平静的眉眼，不置可否缓缓道：“陆明轩说你一字成符，精通变化，易数通透，方才‘离’卦变爻之问，你有何见地？”
“容学生作答！”吴燃灯也不废话，心头已经划过这些天对易数参修的所见所得。
这陆明轩不怀好意，要将他架在火上烤，窥探他的底细。
“想要让我出丑？”他微微而笑。
这些伎俩，实在可笑！
不过这陆明轩的小小心机，倒正好帮了他一臂之力。
这些天，他虽然领悟颇多，但终究是独自领会，正需要找高人指点。
讲堂论易，让葛仙师指正，这不就是一个绝好的机会？
吴燃灯诸多心思眨眼掠过，抬手间，指尖凝起一缕正气，不似他人引灵气为爻，而是以文气在空中勾勒。
笔锋落处，先画“乾”为天，再勾“坤”为地，八卦符号如活物般在半空流转，渐渐凝成一幅先天八卦图，光晕温润，不似寻常术法那般锋芒毕露。
堂内弟子皆点头——果然是符道手法，以符显卦，倒也新奇。
谁知下一瞬，吴燃灯指尖偏转，八卦图突然旋转起来。
“巽”卦之处，气流骤起，竟在堂中布下一道简易的迷踪阵，后排几个弟子眨了眨眼，赫然发现左右邻座的身影变得模糊；
“离”卦方位，火光微动，却不灼热，反而凝成丹炉虚影，炉中似有药香飘出，是“离为火”化炼丹之象；
“艮”卦转动时，堂角那尊镇塾的石鹤摆件突然轻轻震颤，石身上浮现出细密的纹路，竟与炼器时的锻打痕如出一辙；
而“坎”卦流转处，一道柔和的水汽漫过一个面色发白的弟子，那弟子顿时舒展了眉头，像是被祝由之术拂去了不适。
众人皆惊。
这哪里是单以符道演易数？
分明是将八卦之理拆解开，融入了阵法的生克、炼丹的火候、炼器的纹理、祝由的调和，每一处卦象变动，都对应着一门术法的根基。

葛仙师捻须的手停在半空，望着那幅包罗万象的八卦图，眼底泛起惊叹。
吴燃灯指尖一顿，八卦图渐渐消散，只余一缕正气在空中轻轻荡开。
他躬身道：“弟子以为，易数是根，阵、符、丹、器、祝由皆是枝叶。
‘离’卦变爻，若只论一事，是应变；
若观其根，则是让错位的‘数’归位——如阵法纠错、丹火调温、器纹补漏、祝由安神……
千言万句，说到底，都是一个‘正’字。”
堂内静了片刻，忽有掌声响起，先是零星几声，渐渐连成一片。
不提陆明轩难看的脸色，方婉、司乐菡却是似懂非懂，眉头紧蹙。
唯有那些入学已久的老学子们，才各个能心领神会，看向吴燃灯的目光，又惊又叹。
“这代首席不一般啊！能将易数，糅合修仙五术，融会贯通！”
“入学这么短的时间，能将易数参悟到这重境地，后生可畏！”
content_en:
The thin figure is independent, and the sunlight falls on the desk, making the carvings on the half piece of green paulownia wood particularly clear - it is the hexagram line of the word "Yi", and there seems to be a faint light flowing between the lines.
Master Ge Xian glanced at the wooden sign, then looked up and down at the seemingly ordinary student in front of him. When he looked at Wu Randeng's calm eyebrows, he said slowly and noncommittally: "Lu Mingxuan said that you can form a talisman with one word, are proficient in changes, and can easily count. You have just 'Li' a hexagram to change a line. What do you think?"
"Let the students answer!" Wu Randeng didn't talk nonsense, and his mind had already flashed through what he had seen and gained from Yi Shu's cultivation these days.
Lu Mingxuan had evil intentions and wanted to roast him over the fire to spy on his true identity.
"Want to make me look embarrassed?" He smiled slightly.
These tricks are so ridiculous!
But Lu Mingxuan's little trick came to his rescue.
Although he has learned a lot these days, after all, he has learned it alone and needs guidance from an expert.
Discuss Yi in the lecture hall and let Master Ge Xian correct him. Isn't this an excellent opportunity?
Wu Randeng's many thoughts passed by in the blink of an eye. When he raised his hand, a ray of righteousness condensed on his fingertips. It was not like other people who used spiritual energy to form a line, but outlined it in the air with literary energy.
Wherever the stroke of the pen falls, first draw "Qian" for the sky, and then hook "Kun" for the earth. The Bagua symbols circulate in the air like living things, gradually condensing into an innate Bagua picture, with a gentle halo, not as sharp as ordinary magic techniques.
The disciples in the hall all nodded—it was indeed a talisman technique, using talismans to display hexagrams, which was quite novel.
Unexpectedly, the next moment, Wu Randeng's fingertips deflected, and the Bagua diagram suddenly started to rotate.
At the hexagram "Xun", the air flow suddenly rose, and a simple confusion formation was laid out in the hall. Several disciples in the back row blinked and suddenly found that the figures of the neighbors on the left and right became blurred;
In the direction of the "Li" hexagram, the fire light moves slightly, but it is not burning. Instead, it condenses into a shadow of the alchemy furnace. There seems to be a medicinal fragrance wafting out of the furnace, which is the image of "Li turning into fire" for refining elixirs;
When the "Gen" hexagram was turned, the stone crane in the corner of the hall suddenly trembled slightly, and fine lines appeared on the stone, which were exactly the same as the forging marks during the weapon refining;
At the turn of the "Kan" hexagram, a soft stream of water vapor spread over a pale-faced disciple. The disciple immediately relaxed his brows, as if the discomfort had been brushed away by Zhu You's technique.
Everyone was shocked.
How can this be a simple number of talismans?
It is clearly a dismantling of the principles of the Eight Diagrams, incorporating the formation and restraint of the formation, the heat of the alchemy, the texture of the weapon, and the harmony of the blessings. Every change in the hexagram corresponds to the foundation of a technique.
Master Ge Xian's hand twirling his beard stopped in mid-air, looking at the all-encompassing Bagua picture with wonder in his eyes.
Wu Randeng paused with his fingertips, and the Bagua diagram gradually dissipated, leaving only a ray of righteousness gently swinging in the air.
He bowed and said: "Disciples believe that Yi Shu is the root, and formations, talismans, elixirs, utensils, and blessings are all branches and leaves.
The hexagram "Li" changes its line. If it only talks about one thing, it is a response;
If you look at its roots, it means returning the misplaced numbers to their proper places - such as correcting errors in formations, adjusting the temperature of elixir fire, repairing leaks in the patterns of utensils, wishing you peace of mind...
Thousands of words, in the final analysis, all have the word "righteous". "
The hall was quiet for a moment, and suddenly there was applause, scattered at first, and then gradually became one.
Not to mention Lu Mingxuan's ugly face, Fang Wan and Si Lehan seemed to understand, with their brows furrowed.
Only those old students who have been in school for a long time can understand it and look at Wu Randeng with surprise and surprise.
"This generation of chiefs is extraordinary! He can combine Yi Shu with the five skills of cultivating immortals, and master them all!"
"In such a short period of time after enrolling in school, to be able to understand Yi Shu to such an important level is to be feared!"
